assessment: The article by Verstegen et al. examines humoral and cellular immune response in two subgroups of SARS-CoV-2-experienced immunosuppressed patients receiving two doses of mRNA-1273 vaccine. Further understanding the barriers to seroconversion to COVID-19 vaccination in immunosuppressed populations and how best to overcome these challenges are of great importance. The report is well written, logical, focused and thorough.
